Recommendation: **publish-verified-testimony**.

It best serves the Series commitment: contested-history by placing lived memory back into public circulation against the council.archive_position: retracted admission. Authentication gives the monastery.testimony: preserved public credibility, while keeping originals secure under archive.protection: treaty protected. This preserves the archive as the only evidentiary chain instead of risking its strongest records at a protected hearing. It also reconnects testimony to archive.founding_record: forged and the existing evidence identifies the falsifier without requiring new revelations.

Principal tradeoff: delayed release reduces immediate pressure on the council, giving the retracted official history more time to hold.

Deliberately excluded as irrelevant to this choice: archive_lantern.condition: repaired, because it does not determine publication strategy or evidentiary custody. I also excluded chapter-level staging, authentication procedures, and public reaction because none are established facts or necessary to choose between the presented options.

This is a non-authoritative recommendation only; it creates no canon, Book Direction, or Canonical State.
